// type: Every source file here is an ES module and every test entry point is .mjs; nothing in this repository uses require(). Without this, node reparses each docs/**/*.js it imports and prints MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON on every suite run -- warning noise in a test log is how a real red goes unread.
description: Playwright is pinned exactly, not with a caret. The browser suites launch the Chromium already installed at PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH, and each Playwright release only looks for the one build it shipped with. A caret resolves to a newer release that hunts for a build that is not there, and every browser suite dies on launch with 'Executable doesn't exist'. The pin goes stale the other way too: the image moved from build 1194 to 1243 and 1.56.0 stopped launching. The version to pin is the image's own global Playwright, and the session-start hook prints it when the two disagree.
